item.title: September's PlayStation Plus monthly games lineup has leaked online ahead of Sony's official announcement.
item.description: September's PlayStation Plus monthly games lineup has leaked online ahead of Sony's official announcement. As detailed by Dealabs' ever-reliable billbilk-kun, next month's list of titles available to PlayStation Plus subscribers will include last year's Sniper Elite: Resistance, placing you behind the long gun barrel of a British agent infiltrating Nazi-occupied Europe in 1944. "A solid stealth-based shooter," is how IGN's Sniper Elite: Resistance review described the game, affording it a 6/10 score. "It fails to set its sights high enough in order to pull off a truly spectacular execution," we added. Released back in 2022, the classic Japanese role-playing game inspired Chained Echoes is next on the roster. Inspired by classics such as Secret of Mana, Chrono Trigger and Final Fantasy 4, this retro-feeling RPG proudly wears its influences on its sleeve — but is no worse off for doing so.

item.title: Nintendo has revealed its first Switch 2 console bundles for launch following the console's upcoming price rise.
item.description: Nintendo has revealed its first Switch 2 console bundles for launch following the console's upcoming price rise. Two options will be available, offering discounts on purchasing the platform with either Mario Kart World or Nintendo Switch Sports Resort. As a reminder, Switch 2 is set to increase in price within the U.S., Canada, U.K. and mainland Europe in just five days' time, meaning you have a limited window in which to still buy one for its launch price. In the U.S., Switch 2 will rise by $50, to $499.99. From "late September", Nintendo will once again bundle Switch 2 with its launch title Mario Kart World and three months of Nintendo Switch Online membership. This package will sell for $549.99, which Nintendo says is a $37.98 saving. Next, from October 22, a second bundle option will become available alongside the launch of Nintendo Switch Sports Resort. The game and console, plus a 90-day Nintendo Switch Online subscription, will sell for $529.99. This is a saving of $27.98, Nintendo says.

item.title: While everything seems to be going up in price lately, due to an ongoing RAMageddon that doesn't seem to be letting up any time soon, Asus' handhelds have somehow avoided the price increases that are hitting everything in the category. And, while the company's special anniversary version of the Xbox Ally X is a bit more expensive than the regular version, it's not by much.
item.description: While everything seems to be going up in price lately due to an ongoing RAMageddon that doesn't seem to be letting up any time soon, Asus' handhelds have somehow avoided the price increases that are hitting everything in the category. The company's special anniversary version of the Xbox Ally X is a bit more expensive than the regular version, but it's not by much. Preorder ROG Xbox Ally X20 at Best Buy At gamescom, Asus revealed a bit more information about the upcoming gold-themed version of the Xbox Ally X to celebrate ROG's 20th anniversary, called, what else, the Xbox Ally X20. This is essentially the same system as the original Xbox Ally X, just with an OLED display, TMR joysticks, and a fancy new D-pad. Okay, well at least the innards remain the same, with the AMD Ryzen AI Z2 Extreme and 24GB of memory. Back when Asus announced the X20, I was worried this was going to be a sneaky way to refresh the handheld with a couple new features to raise the price to the same degree as something like the Lenovo Legion Go 2 or the Steam Deck — especially since, back then, it was announced as only part of a bundle with the Asus ROG Xreal R1 glasses I reviewed a few weeks ago.

item.title: Avengers star Mark Ruffalo has responded to the suggestion he invoked "antisemitic tropes" in his ongoing criticism of Paramount's $111 billion Warner Bros. buyout.
item.description: Avengers star Mark Ruffalo has responded to the suggestion he had invoked "antisemitic tropes" in his ongoing criticism of Paramount's $111 billion Warner Bros. buyout. Responding to the claim, made in a lengthy and unusual statement by Paramount itself, Ruffalo dubbed the accusation as "appalling and fundamentally dishonest." The issue stems from Ruffalo's continued pressure on Paramount over its controversial takeover of Warner Bros., a transaction that Ruffalo and numerous other Hollywood stars have said will likely result in consolidation, cost-cutting and job losses, plus particular concern surrounding the independence of Warner Bros.' news organization CNN. Paramount is owned by David Ellison, and the buyout's finances will be backed his father Larry Ellison, the billionaire co-founder of technology firm Oracle and the world's sixth-richest person. In an Instagram story last week, Ruffalo commented on a video featuring Oracle vice chair Safra Catz, who discussed Oracle's public backing of the Israeli military in the wake of October 7 terrorist attacks, and the subsequent deployment of what she described as Oracle's "really profoundly scary technology" to the Israeli army.

item.title: Here's when you'll be able to watch Grand Theft Auto 6: An Extended Look as soon as it debuts on Netflix, and when it will arrive on YouTube.
item.description: Netflix will exclusively debut GTA 6 gameplay footage this Thursday, August 27 via its Grand Theft Auto 6: An Extended Look, which will remain exclusive to the streaming platform for six hours. Here's when you can watch the show as soon as it debuts, and when it will arrive on other platforms such as YouTube. While the past week has seen persistent GTA 6 leaks hit the headlines, these short snippets of open-world footage feel like they have only scratched the surface of what Rockstar has been building. Here's hoping this week reveals a good sense of both protagonists, Jason and Lucia, and our best look yet at the game's world in high-definition. The past few months have seen a steady uptick in activity promoting GTA 6 after Rockstar revealed the cover art for GTA 6 back in June. Some fans had expected the game's third trailer to debut shortly after, but Rockstar instead released a big batch of new GTA 6 screenshots, which tease all kinds of new details about the game. It's now been more than 500 days since the arrival of Trailer 2 back in May 2025 — so long ago that when you go back and watch it, the trailer still has GTA 6's previous release date attached to it. But rather than debut its long-awaited Trailer 3 alongside preorders, Rockstar has now confirmed this meatier look at the game, which is now just days away.

item.title: The GTA 6 leaks have continued, this time with two new gameplay videos and a message from the leaker defending their crypto scheme.
item.description: UPDATE: CyberLeek has dropped a third GTA 6 leak video today following on fast from this morning's early releases featuring a nightclub and a beach scene — marking a significant escalation in the amount of footage hitting the internet. This latest release of leaked material also continues to push CyberLeek's supposed agenda behind the leaks: an apparent dislike of the fact that physical media is being abandoned. "People are confused," reads the latest message watermarked into the footage. "This is not about actual discs. It is about ownership. Resale rights still matter — even in a digital-only era." Fittingly, this message is overlaid on gameplay that shows GTA 6 protagonist Jason exploring a video game store, complete with spoof consoles (that look a lot like PS5) and game cases (I wonder if they include the discs!) There's even a sign in the store advertising "ex-rental games and movies for sale." Titles on offer in the fictional shop include games such as Glory Souls 2, Desolate Rim, We Came Together. The leaks certainly appear to be ramping up ahead of Netflix's official GTA 6 reveal (check out the global release times here).

item.title: Discord has countered online reports about Take-Two’s hunt for the identity of the GTA 6 leaker, saying it has yet to be formally served a subpoena, and when it does receive it, it will take a long, hard look at it before responding.
item.description: Discord has countered online reports about Take-Two’s hunt for the identity of the GTA 6 leaker, saying it has yet to be formally served a subpoena, and when it does receive it, it will take a long, hard look at it before responding. On Friday, Andrew L. Carter Jr., Judge of the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York, granted Take-Two's request to subpoena Discord to divulge identifying information about users the Rockstar owner believes are tied to the leaks. Take-Two’s subpoena of Microsoft was also granted. But while Microsoft has issued a statement to say it’s happy to work with Take-Two and Rockstar to help unearth the GTA 6 leaker, Discord issued a different line overnight. “I can share an update on this,” Discord marketing director Ryan K. Rigney said in a tweet. “Discord has not yet been served with a subpoena from Take-Two. When we do, we'll evaluate the validity and scope before responding.”

item.title: IGN has an exclusive excerpt of Baldur’s Gate 3: Astarion, including narration by Astarion actor Neil Newbon himself.
item.description: IGN has an exclusive excerpt of Baldur’s Gate 3: Astarion, including narration by Astarion actor Neil Newbon himself. Baldur’s Gate 3: Astarion, from author T. Kingfisher, is a prequel novel set before the events of Larian’s role-playing masterpiece, Baldur’s Gate 3. It follows Astarion during his time in servitude to the vampire lord Cazador Szarr. Stephen Rooney, one of the senior writers of Baldur’s Gate 3, was consulted to help ensure the novel’s authenticity within the game’s world and lore. The audiobook version is narrated by Neil Newbon, and you can see photos of Newbon in the recording booth below. "This was the one of the very first scenes I wrote, part of getting the geography of the city set firmly into my mind,” T. Kingfisher told IGN. “That was over a year ago and it's hard to believe that the book is so close to coming out. You live with these things in your own head for so long, and I'm delighted that other people will finally get to see it!" Random House Worlds will publish Baldur’s Gate 3: Astarion on September 29, 2026. You can hear Newbon's narration in the video below.

item.title: Pokémon development veteran James Turner is returning to the world of pocket monsters, after previously leaving to make The Plucky Squire.
item.description: Pokémon development veteran James Turner is returning to the world of pocket monsters, after previously leaving to make The Plucky Squire. Turner is notable as being the first Westerner to officially design Pokémon, working for years at the series' core development studio Game Freak. Four years ago, however, Turner departed the company to co-found his own studio, All Possible Futures. This fledgling team then released innovative indie platformer The Plucky Squire, which saw 2D characters leap from their storybook home to explore 3D surroundings. It's unclear what's next for the studio or any potential sequel now Turner has moved on again. Last night, Turner revealed via a post on X/Twitter that he had begun a new role as Creative Director of Pokémon Art and Design at The Pokémon Company International. While this doesn't sound like a development role — meaning Turner's days designing species may be over — it will be interesting to see what he does next.
